name: ComSovereign Holding Corp. 9.25% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock
summary: COMSovereign Holding Corp. is a global technology firm that engineers, produces, and markets advanced telecommunications solutions for a diverse clientele, including network operators, mobile carriers, government entities, and various businesses. The company's portfolio includes microwave packet radio equipment, such as backhaul radios, which facilitate the high-speed transmission of broadband voice, video, and data, empowering organizations to cost-effectively manage escalating bandwidth demands. They also pioneer in-band full-duplex and transpositional modulation technologies, designed to enhance the capabilities of existing transmission systems. Furthermore, COMSovereign provides intelligent battery and backup power solutions crucial for cellular towers, radio access networks, and even applications in the automotive, aerospace, and marine sectors. For national defense and security, they offer tethered drones and aerostats for intelligence gathering, surveillance, reconnaissance, and communication. The company is actively innovating in silicon photonic devices for use in data interconnects, communication infrastructures, and computing platforms. Complementing its product offerings, COMSovereign delivers a full suite of professional services, encompassing maintenance, support, engineering, and design for next-generation network systems and components. Established in Dallas, Texas, in 2014, the company was formerly known as Drone Aviation Holding Corp. before rebranding as ComSovereign Holding Corp. in November 2019.
